description: This file is a C++ source file implementing the 'Warehouse' plugin class. It provides functionalities such as device reset, retrieving device information, front panel control, hardware testing, and reset procedures, often interacting with system scripts and external modules. It also includes RPC wrappers for remote invocation of these functions.

classes.name: Warehouse
classes.description: Main plugin class that manages device reset, information retrieval, hardware testing, front panel control, and system scripts interactions.

methods.name: resetDevice
methods.description: Resets the device, either via IARM bus or by simulating a reboot sequence.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Obtains device hardware and software information by executing a system script and parsing its output.

methods.name: setFrontPanelState
methods.description: Sets the front panel LEDs to indicate download or error states, controlling hardware indicators.

methods.name: internalReset
methods.description: Performs a reset based on the build type, either by executing a script or refusing to reset in production.

methods.name: lightReset
methods.description: Performs a hardware indicator reset by executing a system script that manipulates various hardware components.

methods.name: isClean
methods.description: Checks if certain files or directories are older than a specified age, indicating system cleanliness.

methods.name: executeHardwareTest
methods.description: Triggers a hardware health test via RFC parameter sets.

methods.name: getHardwareTestResults
methods.description: Retrieves the results of the hardware health test via RFC parameters.
